title: 2013 HMMT November Guts Problem 27
statement: Find all triples of real numbers \((a, b, c)\) such that \(a^{2}+2 b^{2}-2 b c=16\) and \(2 a b-c^{2}=16\).

solutions.text: \((4,4,4),(-4,-4,-4)\) (need both, but order doesn't matter) \(a^{2}+2 b^{2}-2 b c\) and \(2 a b-c^{2}\) are both homogeneous degree 2 polynomials in \(a, b, c\), so we focus on the homogeneous equation \(a^{2}+\) \(2 b^{2}-2 b c=2 a b-c^{2}\), or \((a-b)^{2}+(b-c)^{2}=0\). So \(a=b=c\), and \(a^{2}=2 a b-c^{2}=16\) gives the solutions \((4,4,4)\) and \((-4,-4,-4)\).
